facts.fact: Ad Age Best Places to Work 2023 honours 50 companies.
facts.quote: Ad Age Best Places to Work 2023 honours 50 companies that did a standout job over the past year

facts.fact: In Ad Age's Best Places to Work 2023 scoring, employee responses on pay, benefits, and seven other core focus areas make up 75% of the score.
facts.quote: Ad Age’s scoring system factors in employee responses on topics including pay, benefits, and seven other core focus areas (75% of the score).

facts.fact: In Ad Age's Best Places to Work 2023 scoring, company policies and practices make up 25% of the score.
facts.quote: It also factors in a company’s policies and practices in areas including pay and benefits, work/life balance, recruitment, and training and development (25% of the score).

facts.fact: Ad Age's Best Places to Work 2023 competition had separate winner categories for companies with 200 or fewer employees and companies with more than 200 employees.
facts.quote: top companies with 200 or fewer employees and top companies with more than 200 employees

facts.fact: Ad Age produced Best Places to Work 2023 in partnership with Best Companies Group, a research firm.
facts.quote: Ad Age produced Best Places to Work 2023 in partnership with Best Companies Group, a research firm specializing in identifying and recognizing great places to work.

facts.fact: StackAdapt is described by its own press release as used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it has been recognized by Deloitte as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in North America.
